_what: Print-shop rules `kit printcheck --rules <name>` judges a body against. Numbers read off the shop's own pages on the date given; an agent RE-READS the page before an order is placed and updates the date - shops change limits without notice. Add a shop or process as a new key; every field below is used by the check, `notes` is printed with the verdict.

jlc_mjf_pa12.tol_rule: the larger of tol_abs_mm and tol_pct of the dimension
jlc_mjf_pa12.review: automatic check (dimensions, walls, thinnest part, weight) then a manual engineer review of 4-6 business hours; anything the auto-check flagged gets a question or a print-at-your-own-risk
jlc_mjf_pa12.notes: no supports, unfused powder is the support; parts are unpacked and bead-blasted; slits narrower than ~2.5 mm keep their powder; matte grey ~0.1 mm grain, dye black on request; PA12 keeps shape well past 100 C

jlc_9000he.notes: supports on every down-facing surface at the build orientation, ~0.4 mm tips, removed by hand and sanded on outer faces; inside ducting the nubs stay (0.2-0.5 mm); say in the order notes which faces must be built facing up; HDT 60 C - fit checks and painted show parts, not heat or UV service
